children.title: Architecture Authority
children.basis: Authorised 1.1.10 taxonomy; populated only by existing architecture or governed sources
children.description: The Architecture Continuum supplies canonical architectural authority. Its canonical Principle elements solely define the Architectural Axioms. Governance contracts and accepted decisions retain their defined roles; publications and projections supply no independent architectural authority.

children.title: Decision Rights
children.basis: Authorised 1.1.10 taxonomy; populated only by existing architecture or governed sources
children.description: Mark Hunter, Solution Architect, holds final architectural decision and acceptance authority. The Architecture Review Board is the collaborative review and adjudication forum. Agents may analyse and implement authorised work; they cannot approve architecture or confirm their own architectural closure.

children.title: Roles and Responsibilities
children.basis: Authorised 1.1.10 taxonomy; populated only by existing architecture or governed sources
children.description: The Solution Architect adjudicates and confirms the incorporated result. Architecture peers and the ARB may challenge and recommend. Executing agents preserve operative instructions, actual application, evidence and uncertainty within the authorised scope.
